name: hcapp_cancelDownDown
description: Marks a DownDown charge cancelled (IsCancelled = 1, IsDone = 0 — the two are mutually exclusive, so cancelling a delivered charge also clears IsDone). Idempotent. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 60, standard token). @kennelId, @eventId and @downDownId all required (1234 / errorType 2). Gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageDownDowns' for @kennelId (GM / RA by the data-driven matrix) → else 1337 (errorType 3). The UPDATE is keyed on id + EventId + KennelId; no row → 4041 (3). No transaction (single statement). New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event. Used as auth scope and as part of the UPDATE WHERE clause. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event the DownDown belongs to. Used as part of the UPDATE WHERE clause. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

parameters.name: downDownId
parameters.description: DownDown to cancel. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. If no DownDown matches downDownId + eventId + kennelId, returns errorCode 4041, errorType 3.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On any failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the error detail at index 1. ValidateAppAuth 1160 (errorType 1) / 1360 (3) / 1260 (7); 1234 missing parameter (2); 1337 not authorised (3); 4041 DownDown not found (3); 1933 unhandled (5).

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on successful cancel: { success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL }. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope rowset.
Returned (at index 1) alongside the ErrorEnvelope (index 0) on any auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled error.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.DownDowns SET IsCancelled = 1, IsDone = 0, UpdatedAt = GETUTCDATE() WHERE id = @downDownId AND EventId = @eventId AND KennelId = @kennelId (no explicit transaction; single statement).
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled errors.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken, @kennelId, @eventId, @downDownId (lines 3-7) have no SQL default. A client that omits any of them is refused by SQL BEFORE the procedure runs: no HC.ErrorLog row, an empty 500 in the app, and the SP's own graceful checks are unreachable (CLAUDE.md, Rack of Lamb 2026-09-29). The 1234 check at line 67 covers NULL values only.

codeSmells.issue: IsCancelled and IsDone columns are BIT in the table, not SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: HC.DownDowns.IsCancelled and IsDone are declared as BIT NOT NULL. The project standard is SMALLINT. SQL Server implicitly converts the integer literals 0/1 used in the UPDATE. Dart callers must handle these as JSON booleans, not integers, because the .NET shim serialises BIT as JSON boolean.

codeSmells.issue: Not-authorised uses errorType 3 (not found) and the CATCH code 1933 is shared
codeSmells.detail: Line 90 reports a permission refusal as errorType 3, the same family as 'DownDown not found' (4041) — other SPs use 13. Line 133's 1933 is also the unhandled code of hcapp_addDownDown and hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus.
